scenes.say: Eight million pounds. That's what Coulthard says the road from karting to Formula One costs.
Formula One needs a super licence, and that takes forty points, earned with results in junior series.
It starts with karting at around eight. That alone costs hundreds of thousands.
At fifteen you can race Formula Four. The champion gets just twelve points.
Formula Three costs about one and a half million pounds a season, Formula Two over two. But the F2 top three get all forty points.
And age: since twenty sixteen you must be eighteen. The rule came after Verstappen debuted at seventeen.
Formula Two and Formula Three standings are on LapRadar.

title: The road to F1: karting, F4, F3, F2 and 40 super licence points
